HELP_TEXT.BODY:
With this integration, your Shopify store ***{storeDomain}*** is connected to your StayDesk workspace. Here's what you can do:

**Track orders in conversations:** When you open a conversation, the Shopify sidebar will automatically display recent orders for the customer based on their email address. This gives your support team instant context without switching tabs.

**Access order details:** View order status, fulfillment status, and total amount directly within the conversation panel.

WEBHOOK.SIDEBAR_TXT:
Webhooks

Webhooks are HTTP callbacks which can be defined for every account. They are triggered by events like message creation in StayDesk. You can create more than one webhook for this account.

For creating a webhook, click on the Add new webhook button. You can also remove any existing webhook by clicking on the Delete button.

HELP_TEXT.BODY:
With this integration, all of your incoming conversations will be synced to the ***{selectedChannelName}*** channel in your Slack workspace. You can manage all your customer conversations right within the channel and never miss a message.

Here are the main features of the integration:

**Respond to conversations from within Slack:** To respond to a conversation in the ***{selectedChannelName}*** Slack channel, simply type out your message and send it as a thread. This will create a response back to the customer through StayDesk. It's that simple!

 **Create private notes:** If you want to create private notes instead of replies, start your message with ***`note:`***. This ensures that your message is kept private and won't be visible to the customer.

**Associate an agent profile:** If the person who replied on Slack has an agent profile in StayDesk under the same email, the replies will be associated with that agent profile automatically. This means you can easily track who said what and when. On the other hand, when the replier doesn't have an associated agent profile, the replies will appear from the bot profile to the customer.
HELP_TEXT.BODY_ALERT:
With this integration, all of your incoming conversations will be synced to the ***{selectedChannelName}*** channel in your Slack workspace, so your team can pick them up as soon as they come in.

This integration is set to **Alerts only**, which means the Slack thread is a safe space for internal discussion. Anything your team posts there stays in Slack and is never sent to the customer.

**Respond to the customer from StayDesk:** Open the conversation from the link shared in the thread and reply from the StayDesk dashboard. Replies and private notes added in StayDesk keep appearing in the Slack thread, so everyone stays in the loop.

SELECT_CHANNEL.DESCRIPTION:
Your Slack workspace is now linked with StayDesk. However, the integration is currently inactive. To activate the integration and connect a channel to StayDesk, please click the button below.

**Note:** If you are attempting to connect a private channel, add the StayDesk app to the Slack channel before proceeding with this step.

DASHBOARD_APPS.SIDEBAR_TXT:
Dashboard Apps

Dashboard Apps allow organizations to embed an application inside the StayDesk dashboard to provide the context for customer support agents. This feature allows you to create an application independently and embed that inside the dashboard to provide user information, their orders, or their previous payment history.

When you embed your application using the dashboard in StayDesk, your application will get the context of the conversation and contact as a window event. Implement a listener for the message event on your page to receive the context.

To add a new dashboard app, click on the button 'Add a new dashboard app'.
